keyword: is nasa sending people to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.' 'April 1, 2026'; R3: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time' 'April 1, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of launch date and time in R1 and R3.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'four astronauts' 'loop around [the moon]' 'from launch... to splashdown on April 10, the mission is slated to last about nine and a half days'; R2: 'four astronauts... on a 10-day trip around the moon and back'; R4: 'approximately 10-day mission... around the far side of the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm four astronauts, ~10-day mission around Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program 53 years ago'; R2: 'first crewed mission back to the moon... in more than 50 years' 'since... 1972'; R3: 'first time... since Apollo 17, in December 1972' '54-year intermission'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as first crewed lunar flight since Apollo (50+ years).

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, and Mission Specialists Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch and... Jeremy Hansen'; R2: 'Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch, and... Jeremy Hansen'; R3: 'Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander... Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew and roles match across sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon since the Apollo program.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'will not land on the moon or even go into lunar orbit. Instead... loop around it'; R2: 'around the moon'; R3: 'around the moon but not land there'; R4: 'around the far side of the Moon in a figure eight pattern'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm flyby/loop around Moon, explicitly no lunar orbit.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon to include a woman and a Black man.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: no lunar orbit; R2: 'no humans have ventured to lunar realms... since... 1972' but 'around the moon' (no orbit), first woman/person of color beyond LEO; R3: no lunar orbit, firsts for deep space
verifications.reasoning: Mission does not orbit Moon; firsts are for deep space/LEO+, not lunar orbit.
